paragraphs.text: Diori Hamani International Airport (NIM/DRRN) serves as a key air gateway for Niamey, NE, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 09L/27R: 3200 m (10499 ft) unpaved, 09R/27L: 3000 m (9843 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Diori Hamani International Airport with central Niamey include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from NIM should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Diori Hamani International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Diori Hamani International Airport is NIM and the ICAO code is DRRN.

faqs.q: Which city does NIM airport serve?
faqs.a: Diori Hamani International Airport (NIM) serves Niamey, NE.
